mutations: Shared row and column on first callback

limitations: Callback mutation/return probes are controlled C/native endpoints. The three canonical rule predicates execute as real original and C instructions; no other algorithms are controlled.
Mapped, bounded scans are exercised. Native malformed dimensions/counters can wrap into unbounded traversal; such nonterminating/out-of-mapping cases are excluded without production bounds checks.

Callbacks must be real compiled C callables, such as pointers supplied by the accepted restore_placement_rule resolver. This suite does not repair other legacy token-producing callers, input, placement policy or rendering.

integration.production: The four procedures already belong to the production glob. No new runtime source. Coordinator must widen FUN004829b0 to uint32_t in accepted placement_preview.h and its oracle stub, then rerun that unchanged preview corpus. Agent preserved those accepted files.
